summary: Announces a questionnaire sent to every host on the early ARPANET. The answers about each machine's terminals and operation were meant to help the people designing a full Telnet specification. A small committee would phone each site to record answers and publish the results as an RFC; RFC 112 later summarized them.

eli5.summary: Before building a toy that works with every kind of TV, you first ask each family what TV they own. This note is that list of questions, sent to every computer site.
